title: 巴菲特宣布退休 伯克希尔时代落幕
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: If investors had a hall of fame, Warren Buffett would occupy his own wing.
segments.zh: 如果市场参与者有名人堂，巴菲特会独占一个展厅。

segments.en: People from all over the planet look up to him, read his biography, hop on a plane to go see him talk.
segments.zh: 全球各地的人敬仰他，读他的传记，坐飞机去听他演讲。

segments.en: He took a failing textile mill and turned it into a trillion dollar conglomerate, has insurance companies, dairy queens, railroads and energy businesses.
segments.zh: 他把一家濒临倒闭的纺织厂变成了万亿美元的综合企业，旗下有保险公司、奶品皇后、铁路和能源业务。

segments.en: For decades, Buffett's investment savvy has led Berkshire Hathaway to beat benchmarks.
segments.zh: 几十年来，巴菲特的配置智慧让伯克希尔跑赢基准。

segments.en: One of the biggest asset managers today, which is Vanguard.
segments.zh: 如今最大的资管机构之一，先锋领航。

segments.en: The entire philosophy is, no one's really going to be able to beat the market, so you might as well not even try.
segments.zh: 整个理念是，没人真能跑赢市场，所以干脆别试。

segments.en: Well, okay, no one besides Warren Buffett. If you look at the total returns, Berkshire blows the S&P 500 away.
segments.zh: 好吧，除了巴菲特。看总回报，伯克希尔远超标普500。

segments.en: The legendary investor Warren Buffett. So when the 95-year-old announced he would retire at the end of 2025, where we should become the chief executive officer of the company.
segments.zh: 传奇市场参与者巴菲特。当这位95岁的老人宣布将在2025年底退休，公司CEO将接任。

segments.en: It marked the end of an era at Berkshire Hathaway and left everyone with one massive question.
segments.zh: 这标志着伯克希尔一个时代的结束，给所有人留下一个大问题。

segments.en: Warren Buffett is one of the richest people on earth, but his lifestyle doesn't exactly scream it.
segments.zh: 巴菲特是地球上最富有的人之一，但他的生活方式并不张扬。

segments.en: He lives in Omaha, he lives in the same house he's lived for many, many years.
segments.zh: 他住在奥马哈，一直住在同一栋房子里，很多很多年了。

segments.en: He goes to McDonald's in Omaha.
A lot of people around the city know him.
